features: Dynamic bass: The ZEB-Envy 2 headphones allow you to fully enjoy exceptional audio, thanks to the deep bass produced by the dual 40mm powerful speakers.

Connectivity: Enabling wireless connection using BT v5.3, this headphone performs wonderfully. You can connect any audio source to headphones using an AUX cable. The headphones come with a detachable and flexible mic for gaming
Comfortability: For the greatest comfort, these ergonomically designed headphones have soft ear cushions. To strike an immersive gaming session, the headphones come with colorful LED lights.
Dual Pairing: The dual-pairing feature of the headphones enables simultaneous connectivity and easy device switching for a hassle-free listening experience.
Voice assistant: You can easily use this BT headphone's support for the Voice Assistant feature with the aid of the headphone's microphone.
Longer Playtime: You can continue dancing to your favorite tunes for up to 65*hours (*at 50% Volume LED OFF) with this headphone, which charges its rechargeable battery via type-C charging.
Calling function: Enjoy non-stop chit-chatting with your friends seamlessly as these headphones are curated with Environmental Noise Cancellation(ENC).
Controls: With just a button press, you can answer calls by using the media/volume control.
Gaming mode: Focus on your game with the ZEB-Envy 2 wireless headphones as it is curated with offers a low latency gaming experience.
